title: Create a tested BoardCore module
summary: Pan/zoom transforms, selection, snapping, undo, document migrations and proposal generation would regress through visual testing alone. Add a shared BoardCore library/test target and deterministic tests before introducing the interactive editor surface.
acceptance_criteria: XcodeGen defines a shared BoardCore framework or library plus a unit-test target used by the macOS app.
BoardCore imports Foundation/CoreGraphics only where justified and has no SwiftUI, AppKit, WebKit or repository-network dependency.
Tests cover transforms, bounds, IDs, z-order, Codable round trips and unknown schema/object handling.
A deterministic clock and ID generator can be injected into operations and migrations.
The native macOS build and BoardCore tests run through one documented local command.
All existing workflow checks and diff validation pass with zero warnings.

evidence.note: Only iOS and macOS application targets are configured.
The imported design document already contains a large nested model.
The shell combines actions, persistence preferences and mutable loading state.
Current product verification is build-oriented rather than unit-test-oriented.

blocked_by.reason: Required Board foundation must be solved first.

trigger.source_ref: HumbleStudio Board architecture finding HS-BAR-002, requested by Jan.
